menus.name: Menu Dégustation
menus.note: For the whole table; including tax, plus 12% service; limited numbers

menus.name: Menu Spécialité
menus.note: Joël Robuchon's best-known dishes; until 5 November, then ¥78,000 from 6 November to 17 December; book at least three days ahead; lunch or dinner; wine pairing on request

menus.name: Menu Prix Fixe A
menus.note: Choice of two main courses; includes the Imperial caviar dish

menus.name: Menu Prix Fixe C
menus.note: Lunch only (weekends and public holidays); choice of one main course

menus.name: Menu Végétarien
menus.note: Vegetable tasting menu, booked in advance; not vegan

bookingOpens: Online on TableCheck, up to two months ahead, or by phone (11am–8pm). Parties of five or more book by phone and are served a chef's choice menu. The restaurant asks guests to reconfirm three to seven days before.
cancellation: 60% of the meal price from seven to four days before, 80% from three days to the day before, and 100% on the day. Over Christmas (18–25 December) 100% applies from the day before.
groups: Five or more by phone, with a chef's choice menu. The Joël Robuchon Salon upstairs has private rooms.
dressCode: Men are asked to wear a jacket or a collared shirt (a jacket from 18 to 25 December). No T-shirts, shorts or sandals; guests dressed too casually may be turned away.
children: No children under 10 in the main dining room. The private Salon takes children of any age; ask the restaurant.
